text_block_list.text:
At last, the day of the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
has arrived, bringing together the 
strongest Senior-class contenders.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"So many fans have been calling out to me 
since early this morning!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"So I'm totally pumped up and ready to run 
anytime!"
choice_data_list:
Looks like you can really let loose and 
run.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it's a Senior-class race, and 
even if my opponent is McQueen, I won't 
lose!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to show off Lady Teio's true 
skill to your heart's content~!
choice_data_list: Go out there and crush it!
Go out there and do your best!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm off! Cheer me on, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: McQueen, do your best today, for real!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Your fans are cheering for you, aren't 
they? You'd better answer their support.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I shall answer your 
expectations in full. ...With my results 
on the track."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(Too bad for you, though, 'cause I'm in 
top shape too! I'm definitely gonna win, 
no doubt about it!)
